lines.text: Terah din. ₹1,483 crore rupaye. Ramayana is waqt India ki sabse tez kamaane wali filmon mein hai.
Lekin internet pe do sawaal chal rahe hain. Pehla: kya ye Dangal ka 2,070 crore ka record tod degi?
Aur doosra sawaal, jo koi theek se nahi pooch raha: is film pe 4,000 crore lage hain. Kya wo paisa wapas aayega?

Aaj hum kisi ka trade tweet nahi maanenge. Din-ba-din ka data liya hai, aur khud hisaab lagaya hai. Video khatam hote-hote aapke paas teen number honge, jo aap kisi bhi bahas mein screenshot karke bhej sakte ho.
Chapter ek. Ab tak kitna kamaya.
Film paanch November ko aayi. Director Nitesh Tiwari, aur Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi.
Teen din yaad rakhne layak hain. Pehla: opening day, India mein 64.85 crore net.
Doosra: nau November, Diwali ke agle din ka Monday. 107.5 crore. Ek din mein. Ye film ka ab tak ka sabse bada din hai. Pehle aath din mein India net 564.6 crore.

Teesra, aur sabse zaroori: doosra weekend. Asli test wahi hota hai, jab tyohaar ka josh utar jaata hai. Ramayana ne doosre Friday, Saturday, Sunday mein 196 crore aur kamaaye. Matlab log sirf Diwali ki chhutti mein nahi, recommendation sunke bhi aa rahe the.
Phir Monday 32 aur Tuesday 28.7 . Yahan pehli baar film dheemi hui. Chhutiyaan khatam, school aur office wapas.
Terah din ka total: India net 821 crore, India gross 981.5 crore, videsh se 502 crore. Worldwide, kul milake 1,483 crore.

Ek cheez yaad rakhna, aage kaam aayegi. Gross matlab ticket ka poora paisa. Net matlab usme se GST nikal ke. Aur jo paisa producer tak pahunchta hai, wo in dono se kaafi kam hota hai. Wo hisaab chapter paanch mein.
Chapter do. Paisa kahan se aa raha hai.
India ke 821 crore mein se 627 crore sirf Hindi version se aaye. Yaani 76 pratishat. Baaki chaar South bhashaon ne milke 194 crore, jisme sabse aage Kannada hai, 67 crore. Yash ka asar.

Ab ek comparison jo kisi ne nahi dikhaya. Pushpa two Telugu film thi, phir bhi uske 1,234 crore India net mein se 812 crore Hindi dub se aaye the, lagbhag 66 pratishat. Ramayana Hindi film hai, aur uska Hindi hissa 76 pratishat hai.
Matlab Ramayana ka engine Hindi belt hai. Aur aage badhne ki jagah do hi hain: South, aur videsh.
Videsh se 502 crore, kul kamai ka 34 pratishat. Aur doosre weekend pe film chhe naye deshon mein khuli, jinme Indonesia aur Mexico bhi hain.
Ab yahan se asli maza shuru hota hai. Kyunki agle chapter ka hisaab bataayega ki final number kya hoga, aur chapter chaar mein Dangal ke record ka ek twist hai jo trade wale nahi bataate.
Chapter teen. Aur kitna kamayegi? Humara hisaab.
Ab asli kaam. Trade wale bolte hain, do hazaar crore jayegi. Kis base pe? Hum base dikhayenge.

Pehle saat din mein India net 511 crore aaya. Agle saat din mein, Wednesday ki advance booking jod ke, lagbhag 337 crore. Yaani doosre hafte ne pehle hafte ka 66 pratishat rakha. Badi filmon ke liye ye mazboot hold hai.
Iske baad har hafta pichhle hafte ka kitna rakhega? Humne teen case liye. Dheema case: har hafta pichhle ka 40 pratishat. Beech ka case: 50 pratishat. Mazboot case: 55 pratishat.
Dheema case mein India net lagbhag 1,070 crore pe rukti hai, aur worldwide lagbhag 1,890 crore.
Beech ke case mein India net lagbhag 1,180 crore, worldwide lagbhag 2,075 crore.
Mazboot case mein India net lagbhag 1,260 crore, worldwide lagbhag 2,200 crore.
Isme China jaisa koi bada naya market nahi gina. Aur videsh ki kamai thodi dheere badhti maani hai.

Ye bhavishyavani nahi hai, hisaab hai. Agar teesre hafte ka asli number humare beech wale case se neeche gira, to final number bhi neeche aayega. Hum har hafte pinned comment mein asli number se milayenge.
Chapter chaar. Kaunse records tootenge?

Ab ye list dekho. Indian filmon ki sabse badi worldwide kamai. Dangal 2,070 crore. Dhurandhar two, 1,813 . Baahubali two, 1,788 . Pushpa two, 1,742 . Aur Ramayana terah din mein 1,483 pe, number paanch pe. RRR, KGF two aur pehli Dhurandhar ko pehle hi peeche chhod chuki hai.
Humare dheeme case mein bhi Ramayana 1,890 tak jaati hai. Yaani Dhurandhar two, Baahubali two aur Pushpa two, teeno ko paar. Number do pakka dikh raha hai.
Aur Dangal? Beech wala case lagbhag 2,075 . Dangal 2,070 . Bas paanch crore ka farak. Ye sach mein sikka uchhaalne jaisa hai.
Lekin yahan ek twist hai. Dangal ke 2,070 crore mein se 1,535 crore videsh se aaye the, aur unka bada hissa China se. India ke andar Dangal ki gross kamai lagbhag 535 crore thi.

Ramayana India mein terah din mein 981 crore gross kar chuki hai. Matlab India ke andar, Ramayana Dangal se pehle hi lagbhag do guna aage hai. Worldwide record ke liye usse ya to China jaisa market chahiye, ya teesre-chauthe hafte mein mazboot rehna padega.
Chapter paanch. Chaar hazaar crore ka sach.

Ab doosra sawaal. Producer Namit Malhotra ne ek podcast mein khud kaha tha: Ramayana ke dono parts ka budget $500 million hai, yaani lagbhag 4,000 crore. Business Today ke mutabik isme promotion bhi shaamil hai. Part one ka alag kharcha public nahi hai.
Scale samjho: Chandrayaan three mission lagbhag 615 crore ka tha. Ramayana ka budget saadhe chhe Chandrayaan jitna hai.

Ab sabse zaroori baat. 1,483 crore producer ki jeb mein nahi jaate. Ek sau rupaye ka ticket lo. Is film ke data mein gross aur net ka farak dekho to lagbhag 16 rupaye tax mein jaate hain. Bache lagbhag 84 mein se, aam taur pe theatre lagbhag aadha rakhta hai, pehle hafte thoda kam, baad mein zyada. Yaani sau ke ticket pe film wale ke haath lagbhag 40 se 42 rupaye. Videsh mein bhi film wale ko aam taur pe gross ka lagbhag 40 pratishat milta hai. Ye industry ka rough rule hai, har deal alag hoti hai.

Ab beech wale case pe ye rule lagao. India net 1,180 ka lagbhag 45 pratishat, lagbhag 530 crore. Videsh ke lagbhag 660 crore ka 40 pratishat, lagbhag 265 crore. Theatre se film wale tak lagbhag 800 crore.

Phir OTT. Report ke mutabik makers ne dono filmon ke liye 700 crore ka offer thukra diya tha, aur lagbhag ek hazaar crore chahte hain. Agar ek hazaar mila, to Part one ke hisse lagbhag 500 . Satellite aur music ke number public nahi hain, isliye humne nahi jode.
Total: Part one se lagbhag 1,300 crore. Agar chaar hazaar ka budget dono filmon mein aadha-aadha maano, to Part one ka hissa 2,000 hota hai.

To jawab: abhi nahi. Part one akela poora paisa wapas nahi laayega. Lekin ye uska kaam tha bhi nahi. Chaar hazaar crore do filmon ka daav hai. Part one ne Part two ke liye audience bana di hai. Asli hisaab Diwali 2027 mein Part two ke baad poora hoga.
Chapter chhe. Faisla.
To bahas mein ye teen baatein bolo.
Ek: terah din mein 1,483 crore, aur humare dheeme hisaab mein bhi ye Dhurandhar two ko paar karke India ki number do film banegi.
Do: Dangal ka worldwide record bilkul kaante ki takkar hai. Lekin India ke andar Ramayana pehle hi Dangal se do guna aage hai.
Teen: chaar hazaar crore Part one se wapas nahi aayenge, aur aana bhi nahi tha. Part one film wale tak lagbhag 1,300 crore laayega. Baaki ka hisaab Part two karega.

Ab aapki baari. Teesre hafte mein Ramayana India mein kitna net karegi? Apna number comment mein likho. Agle hafte hum asli number se milayenge, aur jiska sabse paas hoga, uska naam pinned comment mein.
Aise hi har trending sawaal ka hisaab chahiye to Doubt Clear subscribe kar lo.
